lines.say: In 1950, UNESCO issued its first statement on race.
In 1972, Richard Lewontin measured where genetic variation lies.

beats.say: In 1950, UNESCO issued its first statement on race. In 1972, Richard Lewontin measured where genetic variation lies.

lines.say: He found about 85 percent of genetic variation is within populations,
and only a small share between so-called races.

lines.say: Traits like skin colour change gradually across space.
Anthropologists call these clines. Racism has no biological basis.
